Thank you for downloading Modular Industrial Pieces! I hope that you find it useful and easy to understand!

This is free to use however you want, personal, commercial, whatever. 
You do not have to credit me, but it would be nice if you could do so :)
To credit me, you can copy and paste this whereever it needs to go: 
Modular Industrial Pieces by Trey Ramm: artstation.com/treyramm

---------------------------------------------------------------------

To Use:
Import the meshes into whatever program you are using. 
Create a material using the texture from the Textures folder. The Targe file will have better
quality, but the PNG will be much smaller in size without a massive loss in quality. You decide 
which you want to use. 
Attach the material to the meshes.
Make some awesome looking levels.

---------------------------------------------------------------------

This pack was created with UE4 dimensions in mind, however it should still work with other engine. 
The default wall is 2m wide and 3m tall.

---------------------------------------------------------------------

If you do use this in a project, I would love to hear about it!
Send me a message on OpenGameArt, Artstation, or by email at p.f.ramm@gmail.com

Thanks for reading and happy developing!
